name: Rescue
goal: Evacuate at least N of M civilians.

name: Sabotage
goal: Destroy the Relay Node within T turns, then evac or kill all.

name: Capture
goal: Stun a Proxy with the Arc Stunner and carry it to evac.
fail: Proxy dies: lose the bonus, not the mission.

name: Quiet Night
goal: Rescue civilians from a tram station.

name: Relay Hunt
goal: Destroy the relay and recover its Relay Core.

name: Hard Shutdown
goal: Fight through the Spire and kill the Cradle Guardian while the killcode uploads.
